I have good news:

notes.title: Data Base issue fix
notes.content:
Hooray!
The problem of the database has been detected and solved.
Survival | Classic has been fixed and works correctly.
But we need take a more time to fix Survival Postapocalypse Now. 
I ask you to treat with understanding and be patient a little.

Submit your suggestions and impressions of the game in Steam Reviews. The best offers will be taken and possibly implemented in the game.

Have enjoy game!

notes.title: Survival | Classic Update
notes.content:
The in-game location has been updated
Underground expanded and merged
You opinions and wishes on reviews - best reward for developing
I hope game enjoy Yours!

notes.title: Survival | Classic update
notes.content:
Added a new part to the main location of the game.
Subway branch on the underground.
A huge work done to optimize the content on the game map. Optimized model rendering, created multi-level LODs.
Please write your wishes and opinion review.
Your reviews is best award for me and the short way to make your wishes come true.
I hope you have enjoy the game!

notes.title: Gameplay broadcasting!
notes.content:
We have launched a broadcast of the game from gaming community members.
Streaming allows potential players to familiarize themselves with the game before purchasing it. And also makes it possible to watch the game of other participants and possibly learn something new about the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem with exiting the settings in the main menu
- Improved the technical part of the UI
- Adjusted nebula rendering distance
- Partially "explored" a new territory under the mountain

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Time for find gifts under Christmas Tree !
They said the best loot is seen there, but very little.
Not under every Christmas Tree.
And trees are fifteen. Can you go around them all?
Also:
- fixed the collision on the Christmas Trees
- fixed a problem with localization enable 
- slightly increased UI performance
So the game will work fine on your old computer!
Have lovely day and weekends!
Cheers!

notes.title: The Holiday atmosphere
notes.content:
We meet the holiday atmosphere and a few edits:

- Christmas trees are installed on the streets of the location
- Improved optimization of large objects on the main map,
now the game should work acceptable even on the weakest computers
- Fixed collisions on some stones and objects

notes.title: Christmas mood. Pre-holiday update.
notes.content:
Small main menu updates for the Christmas Holiday.

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021 !
We wish health good luck and prosperity for everyone.
May the new 2021 be better than the difficult 2020 !

notes.title: Survival | Classic minor update 20.12.03
notes.content:
Survival | Classic minor update:
- Main Menu optimization fix
- New underground locations on Main map was open
Work continues on the creation of the underground part of the game world.
Will glad to see your reviews on store page.
Interesting review - best help for game polish.

notes.title: Survival update.
notes.content:
Small update available.
Full Main Menu rebuild.
Working for game localization and build bunker on main location.

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
Weekend 's update in Survival | Classic :

- A dungeon was added to the game. It 's not that easy to get in. Top loot and increased danger waiting for you
- Reworked top players in main menu
- Game location refined
- Somewhat balanced loot spawn

Have enjoy game and Have lovely weekend

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
- Fix Top PlayersInfo table Download (May be wrong)
- Fix Localisation (Exit menu, Dead Menu)
- Fix Exit menu time Bug
- Fix Use holders on Double click or drop from character inventory now work correct in inventory.
- FIx drop holders on inventory weapon slot when attach them
- Fix unload holders on Shift+RMB

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
A few more improvements for the weekend!

- Fixed lod's on some stationary objects
- Adjusted the number and position of spawn mobs
- Added delay before exiting battle. 10 Seconds
- Several modified and optimized HUD
- Fixed a bug with the entrance to the server
- Fixed duplicate items after death
- Reduced the number of players on the servers to 30 people

We wish you all a pleasant game and a great weekend!

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
Friends we maked some improvements!

Namely:

- Fixed dupe weapon holders after death

- Increased the "life" of the car

- Added damage protection on helmets

- The length of the day and night has been adjusted. The day has become longer. The night is shorter

- Added display of death from mobs in kill-chat

- Added indication of remaining time until revival

- Added a cave to the map. Good luck searching!

- Improved airport near the Atamanino town

- Redone the Siberian military unit

We wish you all a enjoy game!
